meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

howto.what_en: It points a chosen agent group's requests to local Ollama instead of Anthropic API, optionally blocks Anthropic access, writes the model into Claude settings, then rebuilds and restarts.
howto.when_en: Trigger when the user wants a NanoClaw agent group to use a local Ollama model, e.g. to run locally, cut API costs, or try open-weight models.

say_en.text: Switch the my-agent group to local Ollama model gemma4

say_en.text: Make test-group use local Ollama and block Anthropic API
say_en.note: Adds env and blockedHosts, then restarts.

say_en.text: Switch back from local Ollama to Anthropic API for this group
